positive.why: то же через оператор ||, число приведено к тексту
positive.sql: SELECT name || ' (age:' || age::text || ',gender:''' || gender || ''',address:''' || address || ''')' AS person_information FROM person ORDER BY person_information;

negative.why: нет кавычек вокруг пола и адреса
negative.sql: SELECT CONCAT(name, ' (age:', age, ',gender:', gender, ',address:', address, ')') AS person_information FROM person ORDER BY person_information;
SELECT CONCAT(name, ' (age:', age, ',gender:''', gender, ''',address:''', address, ''')') AS info FROM person ORDER BY info;

negative.why: нет сортировки по этому столбцу (сортировка по возрасту)
negative.sql: SELECT CONCAT(name, ' (age:', age, ',gender:''', gender, ''',address:''', address, ''')') AS person_information FROM person ORDER BY age, name;
SELECT CONCAT(name, ' (age:', age, ',gender:''', gender, ''',address:''', address, ''')') AS person_information FROM person ORDER BY person_information DESC;
